Pig Overview
Pig
is one of the many
Beast Forms
, and possibly one of the easiest to obtain. As with the other
Beast Forms
, the effect is "permanent until cured". If you get tired of rolling in the mud, you can always buy an
Un-Pig Juice
. Be warned that Un-Pig Juice is very costly, and can be difficult to find.
For more information on how to navigate being turned into an animal visit the
Beast Forms
page for advice.
In-Game Description
The art of living and fighting as a pig.

Pig Mechanics
Truffle Sniff
Pigs can use Truffle Sniff to dig up random mushrooms.  You can get Myconic XP from Truffle Sniff mushrooms.
Truffle Sniff 1 --
Parasol Mushroom
Truffle Sniff 2 --
Strange Dirt
,
Parasol Mushroom
,
Mycena Mushroom
Truffle Sniff 3 --
Strange Dirt
,
Parasol Mushroom
,
Mycena Mushroom
,
Boletus Mushroom
To add
Does the zone you're in affect Truffle Sniff? -- appears to work more often in zones where expected mushroom is native, e.g. Truffle Sniff 1 may be more likely to succeed in zones with Parasols.
Does the Truffle Sniff level affect the mushrooms dug up?
Riding
As a
Beast Form
, Pigs are not able to use the traditional Horse mounts offered through
Riding
. Instead,
Norbert
in
Animal Town
teaches mount-form to Pig players who are at least level 25. They also teach an ability that increases both land and water speed temporarily.
Equipment
Crafters producing equipment for use by
Pigs
should obtain the
Sigil Scripting
recipe
Pig Inscription,
which allows for the creation of
Pig Malachite
.
This attuned gemstone can be used in any recipe which calls for the use of
Crystals
to create equipment with
Pig
Treasure Effects.
